tagline.en: Laredo to Manitoba, and increasingly signed I-69
tagline.zh: 自拉雷多至马尼托巴，正逐段改挂 I-69

start.en: The Mexican border at Laredo, Texas, where it continues as Mexican Federal Highway 85D
start.zh: 得克萨斯州拉雷多的墨西哥边境，对侧接墨西哥 85D 号联邦公路

end.en: The Canadian border at the Lancaster–Tolstoi crossing, Minnesota, where it continues as Manitoba Highway 59
end.zh: 明尼苏达州兰开斯特—托尔斯托伊口岸的加拿大边境，对侧接马尼托巴 59 号公路

en: US 59 is a border-to-border route and one of the later additions to the system. It runs from the Rio Grande at Laredo to a crossing on the Canadian line north of Lancaster, Minnesota, shadowing US 75 the whole way — never much more than a hundred miles from it — and forms part of the freight corridor that grew up between Mexico, the United States and Canada after 1994.

In Texas it is two different roads. South and west of Houston it crosses brush country and the coastal plain through Victoria and Wharton; northeast of the city it runs through the pine timber of deep East Texas — Livingston, Lufkin, Nacogdoches, Carthage — and through Houston itself it is the Southwest and Eastex freeways, among the busiest urban highways in the country.

North of Texas it reverts to type: the Ouachitas of western Arkansas through Mena and Fort Smith, eastern Oklahoma, the Kansas towns of Chanute, Ottawa and Lawrence, St. Joseph, the western Iowa farm country, and then the length of Minnesota by way of Worthington, Marshall, Detroit Lakes and Thief River Falls.
zh: US 59 是一条边境至边境的路线，也是较晚加入系统的成员之一。它自拉雷多的格兰德河起，通往明尼苏达州兰开斯特以北的加拿大边境口岸，全程与 US 75 若即若离——两者相距很少超过一百英里——并构成 1994 年后在墨西哥、美国与加拿大之间发展起来的货运走廊的一部分。
在得克萨斯州，它其实是两条不同的路。休斯敦以南、以西，它穿过灌丛地带与沿海平原，途经维多利亚与沃顿；城市东北则穿过东得克萨斯腹地的松林——利文斯顿、勒夫金、纳科多奇斯、卡西奇——而在休斯敦市内，它就是西南高速路与东得高速路，属全美最繁忙的城市公路之列。
出得州后，它回归本色：阿肯色州西部的沃希托山区，经米纳与史密斯堡；俄克拉何马东部；堪萨斯的沙尼特、奥塔瓦与劳伦斯；圣约瑟夫；艾奥瓦西部农区；随后纵贯明尼苏达，途经沃辛顿、马歇尔、底特律湖与锡夫里弗福尔斯。

en: US 59 was not part of the 1926 system. It was created in the mid-1930s and has been rebuilt at both ends since. Its northern terminus was originally at Pembina, North Dakota, reached by way of Noyes and St. Vincent; a new road and border station were built north of Lancaster around 1950 and the route was swung onto them, leaving the old segment to be renumbered as a county road.

In Texas the changes were larger. The original route ran south from Tenaha on what is now US 96 to Port Arthur. In 1939 it was truncated at Tenaha and sent south and west instead, on essentially the line it follows today as far as Beeville — but the road on to Laredo had not been built, and traffic was routed via what is now Texas 359 through Alice and Hebbronville.

The modern chapter began in 1991, when Congress named the corridor one of its high-priority routes for what became I-69. Texas has been upgrading US 59 to interstate standards in pieces ever since. In 2014 the state moved US 59 in Laredo onto the northern arm of Loop 20 to reach the World Trade International Bridge, redesignating the old mainline as a business route; part of that new alignment already carries I-69W.
zh: US 59 并不属于 1926 年的原始系统。它于 1930 年代中期设立，此后两端均有改建。其北端点原在北达科他州彭比纳，经诺伊斯与圣文森特抵达；1950 年前后，兰开斯特以北新建了道路与边境站，线位随之改走新路，旧段则降级改编为县道。
得克萨斯州的变动更大。最初的线位自特纳哈南下，沿今日的 US 96 通往阿瑟港。1939 年，它在特纳哈被截短，改向南、向西延伸，走的基本就是今天至比维尔的这条线——但通往拉雷多的道路当时尚未修成，车流须取道今日的得州 359 号公路，经艾丽斯与赫布朗维尔。
当代的篇章始于 1991 年，国会把这条走廊列为高优先级路线之一，后来成为 I-69。此后得州一直分段把 US 59 改建至州际公路标准。2014 年，该州把拉雷多境内的 US 59 移至 20 号环路北段，以直通世界贸易国际桥，并将原主线改编为商务支线；新线位的一部分现已挂上 I-69W 的牌子。

en: Texas's approach to I-69 is to upgrade the road that is already there rather than build a new one, which avoids most of the environmental review and land acquisition that a new corridor would need. The consequence is that US 59 is being converted in short, funded increments, and long stretches remain U.S. Route in law and appearance while carrying interstate traffic.

What keeps them from being signed as interstate is usually access control. In its feasibility study for the section east of Laredo, TxDOT states plainly that US 59 within the study limits does not meet interstate design standards because it is not a controlled-access road. Where access has been bought out and frontage roads built — the Laredo loop, most of the Houston freeways, the Rosenberg–Houston section — the I-69 shields have gone up alongside the US 59 ones.
zh: 得州推进 I-69 的做法，是把既有道路升级，而不是另辟新线，这样可以规避新走廊所需的大部分环境审查与征地程序。其结果是，US 59 只能按已落实资金的短路段逐步改造；许多长路段在法律上与外观上仍是美国国道，却承担着州际公路的车流。
阻碍它们挂上州际公路牌的，通常是出入控制。在拉雷多以东路段的可行性研究中，得州交通部直言：研究范围内的 US 59 不符合州际公路设计标准，因为它并非全出入控制道路。凡已完成出入权收购并修建了辅道之处——拉雷多环路、休斯敦的大部分高速路、罗森堡至休斯敦段——I-69 的盾形标志就已与 US 59 的标志并列竖起。

why.en: No figure exists. US 59 was numbered in the mid-1930s over roads the states had already built, and the current I-69 conversion is funded project by project rather than as a single programme with a published route total.
why.zh: 没有这样的数据。US 59 于 1930 年代中期沿各州已建成的道路编号；当前的 I-69 改造按单项工程拨款，并非一个公布过全线总额的统一计划。

why.en: No authoritative current figure exists. AASHTO leaves U.S. Route mileage to the states and last published a national log in 1989; US 59's Texas mileage has changed repeatedly as sections are rerouted for I-69.
why.zh: 目前没有权威数据。AASHTO 把美国国道里程交由各州统计，最后一份全国里程表发布于 1989 年；随着路段为 I-69 改线，US 59 在得州的里程屡有变化。

why.en: Eight state agencies count their own segments. US 59 is a ten-lane urban freeway through Houston and a rural two-lane road across northern Minnesota; no agency publishes a combined figure.
why.zh: 8 个州的机构各自统计本州路段。US 59 在休斯敦是十车道城市高速路，在明尼苏达北部则是乡村双车道公路；没有任何机构发布合并数字。

label.en: Why the Laredo section is not yet an interstate
label.zh: 拉雷多路段为何尚未成为州际公路

value.en: TxDOT states that US 59 within its Laredo feasibility study limits does not meet interstate design standards because it is not a controlled-access roadway
value.zh: 得州交通部表示，其拉雷多可行性研究范围内的 US 59 不符合州际公路设计标准，因为它并非全出入控制道路

conditionFigures.source: Texas Department of Transportation, US 59 Feasibility Study, Laredo District

value.en: About 10.9 miles of Loop 20 were redesignated US 59 to reach the World Trade Bridge, and 3.6 miles of the old mainline became Business 59
value.zh: 约 10.9 英里的 20 号环路改编为 US 59 以直通世界贸易桥，原主线 3.6 英里改编为 59 号商务支线

conditionFigures.source: Texas Transportation Commission minute order, 2014, in the TxDOT highway designation file for US 59

timeline.en: US 59 is added to the numbered system, several years after the original 1926 plan.
timeline.zh: US 59 加入编号系统，比 1926 年的原始方案晚了数年。

timeline.en: The Texas route is truncated at Tenaha and rerouted south and west towards Beeville.
timeline.zh: 得州段在特纳哈被截短，改向南、向西通往比维尔。

timeline.en: A new road and border crossing north of Lancaster, Minnesota, replace the old northern end at Pembina, North Dakota.
timeline.zh: 明尼苏达州兰开斯特以北新建道路与口岸，取代原在北达科他州彭比纳的北端点。

timeline.en: Congress designates the corridor a high-priority route, the origin of I-69 in Texas.
timeline.zh: 国会将该走廊列为高优先级路线，成为得州 I-69 的由来。

timeline.en: US 59 in Laredo is moved onto Loop 20 to reach the World Trade International Bridge.
timeline.zh: 拉雷多境内的 US 59 移至 20 号环路，以直通世界贸易国际桥。
